name: glossarygo
title: GlossaryGo
description: Search and update a private local YAML glossary
author: kyrylo_avramenko

commands.name: search-term
commands.title: Search Term
commands.description: Find a term in your local glossary

commands.name: ask-glossary
commands.title: Ask Glossary
commands.description: Ask questions grounded in your local glossary using Raycast AI

commands.name: add-term
commands.title: Add Term
commands.description: Add a term and definition to your local glossary

commands.name: create-glossary-file
commands.title: Select Glossary File
commands.description: Select and validate an existing local YAML glossary file

commands.name: reveal-glossary-file
commands.title: Reveal Glossary File
commands.description: Reveal your glossary file or its nearest existing folder in Finder

commands.name: quick-add-term
commands.title: Quick Add Term
commands.description: Quickly add a term and definition to your local glossary

preferences.name: glossaryFile
preferences.title: Glossary File
preferences.description: Select a .yaml or .yml glossary file. Used until you activate a file with Select Glossary File.

scripts.rebuild: npm run build && npm run dev
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
